newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein stable in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were mostly stable in late trading on Tuesday as light buying emerged following a rebound in Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein was quoted at 1,350-55 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, unchanged from the opening.
"The rebound in Malaysia after sharp falls from the morning helped to lift sentiment," one trader said. "There was some light buying, but players are mostly waiting for fresh leads."
The traders said they expected some players to raise the offer price on Wednesday, but added that it was uncertain if the move would find support.
"The near term price outlook is still bearish," one trader said. "Demand has been poor, with buyers not keen on taking positions because of the ups and downs in Malaysia."

Data from Belawan port showed that the MV Dimitris will sail for Rotterdam next Friday with 5,000 tonnes of palm kernel expeller. The MT Seletar will leave the North Sumatran port on Wednesday for Mombasa with 5,000 tonnes of palm oil.
The MV Beat Rice will leave on Tuesday for Pasir Gudang, Malaysia, with 1,630 tonnes of palm fatty acid distillate.
